title: NCT's DARPA contract and military ties as corroboration

tellings.quote: In June of 1991, the Washington Post reported that Noise Cancellation Technologies Incorporated in Lynthicum, Maryland [music] won a $210,000 contract from DARPA or the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency for Research and Development.

plain: In June 1991, Michels says, the Washington Post reported that a company called Noise Cancellation Technologies, of Linthicum, Maryland, had won a $210,000 research contract from DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency. Michels raises it himself on an episode with Dan Sherman, a former sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens. Michels also points to an Office of Naval Research bulletin and the company's own website, and offers the company's military ties as backing for parts of Sherman's account.
